categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Cooltech Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the power equipment industry, focusing on the development, production, and sales of diesel generator sets and related power supply products. The company also engages in power distribution equipment, special vehicle products, engineering services, and aftermarket services. Additionally, it has emerging businesses in new energy and energy storage sectors, including hybrid energy systems and gas generator sets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in diesel generator set design and manufacturing, emphasizing standardization, intelligence, environmental protection, and high quality. It develops hybrid energy systems integrating diesel, battery, wind, and solar power, and gas generator sets capable of combined heat and power production. The company also invests in R&D for energy storage, hydrogen fuel cells, and smart microgrid integration, supported by a strong patent portfolio and technical collaborations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include data centers, telecommunications operators, high-end manufacturing industries such as semiconductors, power utilities, transportation, petrochemical, engineering, ports, and shipbuilding sectors. The company serves major domestic telecom operators and internet companies, as well as overseas markets, particularly in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. It also targets emerging markets with limited grid infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with sales and service networks covering 30 provinces and cities. It has subsidiaries and service points in Hong Kong, Singapore, Indonesia, and Malaysia, supporting overseas market expansion. The overseas business focuses on Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and Africa, leveraging local partnerships and adapting products to international standards.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Cooltech Power operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain. It manufactures and assembles generator sets and power distribution equipment, integrates systems, and provides engineering and after-sales services. The company relies on upstream suppliers for key components like engines, mainly imported or joint-venture brands, while also exploring domestic alternatives to mitigate supply risks.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes consolidating its core power equipment business, enhancing engineering installation and aftermarket services, and transforming into an integrated energy system solutions provider. R&D priorities target hybrid energy systems, gas generator sets using clean fuels, energy storage technologies, hydrogen fuel cells, and smart microgrid integration. It emphasizes innovation to meet evolving data center and AI computing power demands and supports carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of diesel generator sets, power distribution equipment, and special vehicles. The company also earns income from engineering services, equipment leasing, and aftermarket maintenance services. Additionally, it derives revenue from new energy product sales and investments in related subsidiaries, with a focus on expanding overseas direct sales and project-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few publicly listed domestic enterprises specializing in diesel generator sets, holding a leading position in the data center and telecommunications backup power market segments. It competes with international and joint-venture brands, especially in high-power engine supply. Its competitive advantages include strong brand recognition, extensive technical expertise, stable supply chain partnerships, and comprehensive service networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.27 billion, representing a 16.54% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 35 million, up 8.45%. Total assets reached RMB 1.86 billion, growing 10.7% year-over-year. The company maintains steady growth driven by expanding domestic and overseas markets, particularly in data center and telecommunications sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Cooltech Power emphasizes high-quality, standardized, intelligent, and environmentally friendly power solutions tailored to critical applications requiring reliable backup power. Its products offer flexibility with hybrid energy integration and meet stringent performance and environmental standards. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive system integration capabilities, strong engineering and after-sales services, and a robust global service network ensuring rapid response and customer support.
